title: Seal-Whisper Listener
text: Seal-Whisper Listener presses its ear to buried locks and repeats the thoughts of anyone standing nearby. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The door has learned your voice.

defeatReward.text: Seal-Whisper Listener is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
